Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), initial_network_requirements.pdf (network checklist).

Please reply with preferred peering windows and the SSO metadata file. If you prefer another target date, flag it here and we will update the MAP accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
